description: This file defines the 'RemoteModule' class and associated functions for creating and managing remote modules via PyTorch RPC framework. It enables remote creation, invocation, and parameter access of neural network modules on distributed nodes, with support for TorchScript compatibility and RPC serialization.

classes.name: RemoteModule
classes.description: A class that creates a remote wrapper around an nn.Module, allowing method calls to be executed on a remote process via RPC. It handles RPC initialization, remote creation, and method forwarding, providing an interface similar to nn.Module but for distributed remote execution.

classes.name: _RemoteModule
classes.description: Internal base class providing core RPC-based remote module functionalities, including attribute handling, RPC call management, and pickling support.
